title: Text Descriptors Formats V1.5
description: Text descriptor content formats used when Text Descriptors are produced by a neural model rather than the MPAI-native Basic (POS/NE/dependency/SRL tagging) form. Uses oneOf with const+description so each value is self-documented.

oneOf.description: Contextual token/sentence embedding from the BERT bidirectional transformer (Devlin et al. 2019); 768-dimension representations widely used as an NLP front-end.
Robustly optimised BERT pretraining (Liu et al. 2019); contextual embeddings for downstream language understanding.
Sentence-level embedding from a siamese/triplet BERT network (Reimers & Gurevych 2019) compared by cosine similarity; used for semantic similarity and retrieval.
Industrial NLP pipeline producing part-of-speech, named-entity, and dependency-parse annotations; a common source of the Basic taggings when serialised.
Dependency parse following the Universal Dependencies annotation scheme (de Marneffe et al.), a cross-lingual grammatical-structure representation.
Semantic Role Labelling annotation following the PropBank predicate-argument scheme (Palmer et al. 2005).
Sentence/document embedding from a generative pretrained transformer, used for semantic similarity, clustering, and retrieval.
Static distributional word embedding (Mikolov et al. 2013); 300-dimension vectors capturing lexical semantics.
Global word-vector embedding from co-occurrence statistics (Pennington et al. 2014).
